metadata: Race two revisions, keep both, then resolve what you've read. A live multi-value register running watershed's compiled Gleam kernel.
Race two revisions, keep both, then resolve what you've read. A live multi-value register running watershed's compiled Gleam kernel.
A survey-sheet card reading “Edit upstream. Converge downstream.” (watershed, collaborative data structures for Gleam).
desktop.hero: REGISTERS / REVISION SLATE Converged. Still two answers. A last-write-wins cell would discard one revision. This one keeps the disagreement. Race "raise crest" against "arm pump": all three clients reach the same two alternatives. Nothing is stuck in transit. Once you've read both, resolve with "raise crest + arm pump". That's an ordinary write, not a special conflict API. An unseen third revision would survive it.
desktop.demoIntro: Confirmed alternatives stay in ink; your pending revision appears in magenta. Cut Client B's link, write on both sides, then restore it. Agreement means every crew sees the same alternatives, not necessarily a single answer. Re-deliver keeps an earlier delta even after resolution. The old revision stays retired. Reset tears off a fresh slate and discards delayed work from the previous one.
desktop.mergeRule: Merge rule: keep concurrent alternatives. Two revisions can converge without agreeing on one answer. After both arrive, write a combined revision to replace the alternatives you've seen.
